data.body: Merged: change 3432 at 5532b97b1f802bcfdf114302cc78939abe9b2923 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 on PS2). AC evidence on origin/main 70b43262ae755785ac2e5ce1c29145a4ef244d8b, 2026-11-18 PST: `pytest tests/unit/test_release_workflow_pins.py` 32 passed (with test_release_build_check: 36); `gh api .../autobump.yml --jq .state` = active; Formula/rebar.rb url = nava_rebar-0.16.0.tar.gz and PyPI latest = 0.16.0; token dispatch run 44392705016 conclusion success (comment above); latest tap run 44430718701 (schedule) success. Unverified: the homebrew_tap job's first live run, which happens on the next release dispatch; no release was cut. Root cause: the tap bumped only on a schedule, and GitHub disables schedules after 60 days of repo inactivity, which the tap reaches between releases because it commits only on a bump.
